title: QUADRIGA scaffolding

creators.name: Schnaitter, Hannes
creators.affiliation: Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin, Institut für Bibliotheks- und Informationswissenschaft

description:
scaffold keeps the shared files of a QUADRIGA Open Educational Resource (OER) in sync with the versions packaged in this repository. Starting from an OER that was created with the QUADRIGA Book_Template, it compares the OER against the packaged metadata scripts (quadriga/), the shared CSS and JavaScript (_static/), the Sphinx extensions (_ext/) and the metadata GitHub Action, reports every difference with a git-style status letter and, with --update, writes the current files and removes retired ones. Files that belong to the individual book (for example _config.yml, _toc.yml, chapters, notebooks, assets, the bibliography and the requirements) are never touched, and symlinks or non-empty directories that the manifest wants to delete are reported instead of being removed.

The package ships the shared files themselves, so a single command updates an OER without a checkout of the template or of this repository. The tool requires Python 3.11 or newer and installs from Git with uv tool install or pipx.

QUADRIGA is the data literacy centre for the Berlin-Brandenburg research region. It creates self-study materials for the domains Digital Humanities and Public Administration as Open Educational Resources in the form of Jupyter Books, based on case studies and a data literacy framework. QUADRIGA is funded by the German Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space (BMFTR) and by the European Union as part of NextGenerationEU.
